subtitle: Nagabhata I and the long war of the Sindh frontier

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of a dusty frontier plain with two distant armies facing off under a red dusk sky
panels.action: Nagabhata I sits astride a warhorse on a rocky rise, cloak and hair whipped by frontier winds, watching distant Arab cavalry banners shimmer on the horizon beyond thorn-scrub and scattered forts.

dialogue.text: Two centuries later, a stone at Gwalior boasted that Nagabhata crushed a mlechha army—yet the chronicles speak instead of raids, coalitions and a long, uncertain frontier war.

i18n.hi: दो सौ साल बाद, ग्वालियर की शिला ने शेखी बघारी कि नागभट्ट ने एक म्लेच्छ सेना कुचल दी — पर कथाएँ तो लूट, गठजोड़ और लंबी, अनिश्चित सरहदी जंग की बोलती हैं।

panels.shot: wide aerial shot following the Indus down to the Arabian Sea, then sweeping east toward the Thar and the Malwa plateau
panels.action: The river Indus winds like a dark ribbon to the sea, beyond which tiny ships approach; eastward, the landscape shifts into desert, scrub and scattered strongholds on the Malwa plateau.

dialogue.text: In 711, Arab forces crossed the sea to Sindh. Within a decade, the frontier ran like a raw, open edge between the Indus and the lands of Rajasthan, Gujarat and Malwa.

i18n.hi: ७११ में अरब सेनाएँ समुद्र पार कर सिंध पहुँचीं। कुछ ही बरसों में सीमा सिन्धु से लेकर राजस्थान, गुजरात और मालवा की धरती तक कच्चे, खुले घाव जैसी खिंच गई।

panels.shot: medium wide interior of a governor’s hall in Sindh, lit by oil lamps, maps spread on a low table
panels.action: An Arab governor in Sindh, in simple robe and turban, stands over rough maps of the frontier, officers around him gesturing toward scribbled names like 'Uzain' and outlines of forts to the east.

dialogue.text: From Sindh, the new rulers probed east. Baladhuri’s Futuh al-Buldan speaks of expeditions toward Uzain, Ujjain to later generations, testing roads, rulers and tribute.

i18n.hi: सिंध से नए हाकिम पूरब टटोलने लगे। बलाधुरी की फ़ुतूह अल-बुलदान उज़ैन यानी उज्जैन की ओर चढ़ाइयों का ज़िक्र करती है, जो रास्तों, राजाओं और लगान को परखती थीं।

panels.shot: medium close-up of Nagabhata in a rugged frontier camp, half in shadow
panels.action: Nagabhata I, young but hardened, stands in a small camp of leather tents and rough-hewn stakes, hand resting on a spear, eyes fixed toward the west where the sun sinks over the desert.

dialogue.text: Along this edge rose Nagabhata, a Gurjara-Pratihara chief of the frontier. Not yet the lord of Kannauj, he was first a border captain between desert, pasture and trade-road.

i18n.hi: इसी धार पर उभरे नागभट्ट, सीमा के गुरजर-प्रतिहार सरदार। अभी कन्नौज के स्वामी नहीं, पहले तो वे रेगिस्तान, चरागाह और व्यापार-राह के बीच के बार्डर कप्तान थे।

panels.shot: wide shot of a council of frontier chiefs around a campfire under the night sky
panels.action: Nagabhata sits cross-legged by a low fire with other rugged chieftains, their clothes marked by different clans—Gurjara, Chalukya, local desert lords—faces lit by flame as they argue and gesture over stones laid as markers on the ground.

dialogue.text: This was no lone duel of faiths. Frontier politics drew many. Gurjara-Pratiharas, Gujarat Chalukyas under Pulakesi Avanijanashraya, desert clans like the later-remembered Guhilas—all weighed risk, plunder and survival.

i18n.hi: ये किसी एक धर्म की अकेली भिड़ंत नहीं थी। सरहदी सियासत में कई खेमें थे — गुरजर-प्रतिहार, पुलकेशी अवनिजानश्रय की अगुवाई वाले गुजरात चालुक्य, और बाद में याद किए गए गुहिलों जैसे रेतीले क़बीले — सब जोखिम, लूट और बचाव तौल रहे थे।

panels.shot: medium shot focused on Nagabhata’s face as he listens intently to a messenger
panels.action: Nagabhata leans forward, brow furrowed, as a dust-covered rider kneels before him, hands raised, describing with his fingers the arc of an approaching raid, while distant torches burn on the horizon.

dialogue.text: News came of Arab columns probing Gujarat, of sudden raids and withdrawals. The aim was pressure, levy, control of routes—more than settled conquest in these early years.

i18n.hi: खबरें आईं कि अरब दस्ते गुजरात की टोह ले रहे हैं — अचानक धावे, फिर वापसी। मक़सद था दबाव, बसूली और राहों पर पकड़, न कि अभी की तरह ठोस फतह।

panels.shot: wide dynamic shot of cavalry and infantry moving through thorny terrain at dawn
panels.action: Nagabhata rides at the head of a mixed band of horsemen and foot soldiers across rocky, thorny ground, pale dawn light catching on mail, spears and bows as they move in wary silence.

dialogue.text: Nagabhata’s strength lay in movement. Small, fast detachments watched passes, wells and caravan lines, harrying invaders and allies alike when the balance of advantage shifted.

i18n.hi: नागभट्ट की ताकत थी हलचल। छोटी, तेज टुकड़ियाँ दर्रों, कुओं और काफ़िला-राहों पर नज़र रखतीं, मौक़ा बदलते ही घुसपैठियों और उनके साथियों दोनों को डस लेतीं।

panels.shot: tense medium wide of a standoff between two scouting parties on a rocky ridge
panels.action: On a rocky ridge, Nagabhata’s scouts on sturdy horses stare across a narrow gap at a small group of Arab riders in helmets and mail, both sides unmoving, hands resting near sword and bow.

dialogue.text: The Arab sources speak of skirmishes, of villages burned and forts tested, but not of Ujjain held. The frontier bit back, often in the form of men like Nagabhata.

i18n.hi: अरबी स्रोत झड़पों, जली बस्तियों और आज़माए क़िलों की बात करते हैं, पर उज्जैन पर कब्ज़े की नहीं। सरहद ने जवाबी काटा, अक्सर नागभट्ट जैसे मर्दों के रूप में।

panels.shot: wide battle tableau from a distance, with swirling cavalry on a dusty plain
panels.action: From a distant rise, we see knots of cavalry clash and wheel on a vast dusty plain, banners barely visible through the haze; Nagabhata at one flank points his sword to direct a charge, while allied contingents move in concert.

dialogue.text: Later memory would compress these years into a single great ‘Battle of Rajasthan’. The evidence instead shows repeated encounters—coalitions forming, striking, dissolving, then forming again.

i18n.hi: बाद की यादों ने इन वर्षों को एक ही ‘राजस्थान की महालड़ाई’ में समेट दिया। सबूत तो बार-बार की भिड़ंत दिखाते हैं — गठजोड़ बनते, वार करते, बिखरते और फिर नए सिरे से बनते।

panels.shot: medium close-up of Nagabhata catching his breath after battle, with exhausted troops behind
panels.action: Nagabhata stands amid exhausted soldiers who sit or lean on their weapons, the dust of battle still in the air; his face is streaked with sweat, gaze turned toward a distant line where the enemy has withdrawn.

dialogue.text: Sometimes the frontier lords held the field. Baladhuri hints at Arab setbacks, commanders slain, raids that did not secure lasting rule deeper into Malwa or the heart of Rajasthan.

i18n.hi: कभी-कभी सरहदी सूरमा ही मैदान पर डटे रहे। बलाधुरी अरब नाकामियों की आहट देता है — मारे गए सेनापति, ऐसी लूट जो मालवा या राजस्थान के भीतर तक टिकाऊ हुकूमत न बना सकी।

panels.shot: intimate interior shot of Nagabhata in a small shrine or family hall, contemplating
panels.action: In a dim stone hall, Nagabhata stands before a simple household shrine, helmet and sword laid aside, tracing with his finger the carved names of ancestors on a pillar, his face thoughtful and grave.

dialogue.text: To later poets, Nagabhata became a royal protector of dharma. In his own day, his choices were also those of a border clan leader—tax, tribute, alliance, revolt—measured against kin and land.

i18n.hi: बाद के कवियों के लिए नागभट्ट धर्म के रक्षक राजा बने। पर अपने समय में उनकी चालें एक सीमा-कुल नेता की भी थीं — लगान, राजस्व, संग, बगावत — सब कुछ खानदान और ज़मीन के तराज़ू पर तौला गया।

panels.shot: close-up of a chiselled stone inscription being carved by a mason’s hand
panels.action: A mason’s hand drives a chisel into stone, slowly revealing crisp Nagari letters, while Nagabhata stands in the background, half-seen, conferring with scribes about the wording of his titles.

dialogue.text: Epigraphers place Nagabhata’s rise in the mid-eighth century. In time he claimed wider titles, suggesting that his frontier successes opened the way to Malwa and the old prestige city of Ujjain.

i18n.hi: शिलालेख विद्वान नागभट्ट के उभार को आठवीं सदी के बीच में रखते हैं। आगे चलकर उनके पदनाम फैले, जिससे लगता है कि सरहद की जीतों ने मालवा और पुरानी महिमा वाली उज्जैन तक राह खोली।

panels.shot: wide shot of Ujjain’s skyline with temples and river, with Nagabhata’s retinue approaching
panels.action: The cityscape of Ujjain rises above the Shipra river, temple spires and houses crowding the bank, as Nagabhata’s compact but disciplined retinue enters along a dusty road, banners snapping in the breeze.

dialogue.text: Al-Baladhuri’s ‘Uzain’ appears as a target. Yet in the end, it is Nagabhata we find associated with Ujjain, suggesting that frontier resistance preserved space for his own ascent there.

i18n.hi: अल-बलाधुरी का ‘उज़ैन’ एक निशाने की तरह आता है। पर अंत में उज्जैन से नाम नागभट्ट ही जुड़ता है, मानो सरहदी प्रतिरोध ने वहीं उनके उभार की जगह बचा ली।

panels.shot: medium interior shot of a later Pratihara court, with a court poet reciting
panels.action: In a more opulent later hall, a court poet declaims with animated gestures before a Pratihara king, while behind him a stone slab—the future Gwalior Prashasti—stands half-finished, scribes taking notes.

dialogue.text: Around 875, the Gwalior Prashasti of Mihira Bhoja looked back. It spoke of Nagabhata crushing a great army of mlechhas, the enemy unnamed, the scene unlocated, the language soaring with praise.

i18n.hi: करीब ८७५ में मिहिर भोज की ग्वालियर प्रशस्ति ने पीछे मुड़कर देखा। उसमें नागभट्ट को म्लेच्छों की विशाल सेना चूर करने वाला बताया गया — दुश्मन बेनाम, जगह अनकही, भाषा आसमान छूती श्लाघा की।

panels.shot: split-focus shot: in the foreground, the inscription words; in the background, ghostlike scenes of frontier skirmishes
panels.action: The carved words of the Gwalior inscription fill the foreground, while in the hazy background appear faint, overlapping images of frontier battles, forts, and councils, as if memory itself is stitching scattered events together.

dialogue.text: Historians read this carefully. The inscription is panegyric, but it echoes real pressures from Sindh, real raids eastward, and real resistance by a frontier coalition in which Nagabhata stood prominent.

i18n.hi: इतिहासकार इसे फूँक-फूँक कर पढ़ते हैं। लेख प्रशंसा का है, पर सिंध की सच्ची दबावों की गूंज भी है — सचमुच की पूरबी लूटें और वो सरहदी गठजोड़, जिसमें नागभट्ट साफ़-साफ़ उभरे।

panels.shot: wide temporal montage shot, showing shifting rulers on the frontier over several decades
panels.action: A cinematic montage shows, like fading layers, Arab governors in Sindh, changing local chiefs in Gujarat and Rajasthan, and Nagabhata growing older amid councils and campaigns, the landscape remaining the constant frame.

dialogue.text: Across the mid-eighth century, the Sindh frontier stayed unstable. Arab power held the lower Indus; inland, men like Nagabhata built their fortunes by managing this instability rather than ending it.

i18n.hi: आठवीं सदी के बीचोंबीच सिंध की सरहद डगमग ही रही। अरब ताकत निचले सिन्धु पर जमी रही; अंदरूनी इलाक़ों में नागभट्ट जैसे लोग इस अस्थिरता को ख़त्म नहीं, संभालकर ही अपनी किस्मत गढ़ते रहे।

panels.shot: medium shot of Nagabhata overlooking a map of northern India, with Kannauj marked distantly
panels.action: Nagabhata stands over a painted cloth map laid on a low table, his finger resting on Ujjain while, farther away, the symbol for Kannauj glows faintly under lamplight, hinting at a future yet to come.

dialogue.text: From these edges, the Gurjara-Pratihara path would one day lead to Kannauj. Nagabhata’s frontier career laid foundations, but his fame would be enlarged by descendants who needed heroic founders.

i18n.hi: इन्हीं किनारों से गुरजर-प्रतिहारों की राह एक दिन कन्नौज तक पहुँची। नागभट्ट की सरहदी ज़िंदगी ने नींव रखी, पर उनकी शान बढ़ाई वंशजों ने, जिन्हें हीरो पुरखे चाहिए थे।

panels.shot: close-up of Nagabhata’s weathered profile at sunset, half-lit, facing the west
panels.action: At sunset on a rocky outcrop, Nagabhata stands alone, profile sharp against the orange sky, gaze turned west toward the unseen Indus and Sindh, cloak stirring in the cooling wind.

dialogue.text: On the record’s edge, Nagabhata remains a frontier silhouette—his victories, coalitions and defeats only partly visible, yet enough to show us how empires meet and negotiate the line between them.

i18n.hi: दस्तावेज़ों की मर्यादा पर नागभट्ट अब भी एक सरहदी परछाईं हैं — उनकी जीतें, मेल-जोल और हारें आधी-अधूरी दिखती हैं, पर इतनी तो हैं कि समझ में आए कि साम्राज्य कैसे मिलते हैं और अपने बीच की लकीर तय करते हैं।
